products.name: Chitragupt
products.tagline: Household tax review for salaried Indian filers.
products.blurb: Upload Form 16, AIS, 26AS and bank statements. It pulls out the numbers, picks the right ITR form, compares old against new regime, and hands you a CA-ready PDF.
products.modelDetail: One payment per assessment year, and nothing auto-renews — the site's own words are “one plan per AY, no subscription”. There is a free tier that is not time-limited: uploading and storing documents is free, and past-AY reviews stay free. You pay when you want the answers. Paid tiers are refundable within 14 days if you have not exported.

tiers.label: Pro Family
